problems.quote: Lok Sabha has a maximum strength of 543 elected members
problems.problem: The maximum strength of Lok Sabha is 550 (530 from states + 20 from UTs); 543 is the current actual strength, not the constitutional maximum.
problems.correction: Lok Sabha has a maximum strength of 550 elected members
problems.verifierReason: Constitution caps elected seats at 550; 543 is current, not maximum.

problems.quote: Note that Kangchenjunga is not in India but on the border; the highest peak entirely within Indian territory is Nanda Devi.
problems.problem: Kangchenjunga is an alternative spelling of Kanchenjunga, the same peak that lies on the India–Nepal border; it is not correct to say it is 'not in India' – the summit is on the border and is considered the highest peak in India.
problems.correction: Note that Kanchenjunga (Kangchenjunga) lies on the India–Nepal border; the highest peak entirely within Indian territory is Nanda Devi.
problems.verifierReason: Original wrongly states Kangchenjunga 'not in India'; summit is on India–Nepal border and counts as India's highest peak. Correction is accurate.

problems.quote: Kanchenjunga is in Sikkim, but Kangchenjunga is on the border with Nepal.
problems.problem: Kanchenjunga and Kangchenjunga are two spellings of the same mountain; it is located on the border between Sikkim (India) and Nepal, not in two different places.
problems.correction: Kanchenjunga (Kangchenjunga) lies on the border between Sikkim and Nepal.
problems.verifierReason: Original treats Kanchenjunga/Kangchenjunga as two separate peaks; they are alternate spellings of the same border mountain. Correction fixes this.

problems.quote: clearance under the Inter‑State River Water Disputes Act 1956
problems.problem: The Inter‑State River Water Disputes Act 1956 provides for adjudication of water disputes, not for project clearance. Links require environmental clearance under the Environment (Protection) Act 1986 and techno‑economic appraisal by the Central Water Commission.
problems.correction: environmental clearance under the Environment (Protection) Act 1986 and techno‑economic appraisal by the Central Water Commission
problems.verifierReason: ISRWD Act 1956 is for dispute adjudication, not project clearance. Correction cites correct statutes (EPA 1986, CWC appraisal).

problems.problem: Incorrect term; the official name is Paralympic Games (or Paralympics).
problems.verifierReason: Para Olympics is not official; Paralympic Games is correct.

problems.quote: 2003 adoption of a Super Eight stage
problems.problem: The 2003 Cricket World Cup used a Super Six stage, not Super Eight; Super Eight was introduced in 2007.
problems.correction: 2003 adoption of a Super Six stage
problems.verifierReason: 2003 WC used Super Six; Super Eight introduced in 2007.

problems.quote: 2015 decision to revert to a straight knockout after a single group phase
problems.problem: The 2015 World Cup had two groups followed by knockout; a single group phase was used in 2019.
problems.correction: 2019 decision to revert to a straight knockout after a single group phase
problems.verifierReason: 2015 WC had two groups; single group knockout format was 2019.

problems.problem: GoalControl is a camera‑based system, not magnetic‑field; the magnetic system is GoalRef.
problems.verifierReason: GoalControl uses cameras; magnetic system is GoalRef.

problems.quote: the mid‑section area (which for a pyramid frustum equals √(A₁A₂))
problems.problem: The mid-section area of a pyramid frustum is not the geometric mean of the end areas; it is the area at half the height.
problems.correction: the mid‑section area (which for a pyramid frustum is the area at mid‑height)
problems.verifierReason: Mid-section area of pyramid frustum is not geometric mean; it's area at mid-height. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: The volume in both cases is (4/3)πa²b or (4/3)πab² respectively
problems.problem: The volume formulas for prolate and oblate spheroids are swapped. Revolving an ellipse about its major axis (prolate) gives volume (4/3)πab²; about its minor axis (oblate) gives (4/3)πa²b.
problems.correction: The volume in both cases is (4/3)πab² or (4/3)πa²b respectively
problems.verifierReason: Original swaps prolate/oblate volumes; correction matches standard formulas.

problems.quote: at a rate proportional to the water height (Torricelli’s law)
problems.problem: Torricelli's law states that the efflux velocity is proportional to the square root of the water height, not the height itself.
problems.correction: at a rate proportional to the square root of the water height (Torricelli’s law)
problems.verifierReason: Torricelli's law gives rate ∝ √h; original says ∝ h, correction correct.

problems.quote: 1 + R/100 = 10 log(A/P)/T (or e ... for natural logs), and finally R = 100(10 log(A/P)/T - 1)
problems.problem: Missing exponentiation when converting from logarithm to antilogarithm; the antilog of log(A/P)/T is 10 raised to that power, not 10 multiplied by it.
problems.correction: 1 + R/100 = 10^(log(A/P)/T) (or e^(ln(A/P)/T) for natural logs), and finally R = 100(10^(log(A/P)/T) - 1)
problems.verifierReason: Original omitted exponentiation; correction uses proper 10^ (or e^) to invert the log.

problems.problem: Missing exponentiation; the expression should be e raised to the power (ln(A/P)/n), not e multiplied by ln(A/P)/n.
problems.verifierReason: Original missed exponentiation; correction correctly applies e^(ln(...)/n) - 1.

problems.quote: This harmonic‑mean relationship is a favourite examiner shortcut.
problems.problem: The expression (t_walk × t_stand) ÷ (t_walk + t_stand) is not the harmonic mean; it is half the harmonic mean. The harmonic mean of two numbers a and b is 2ab/(a+b).
problems.correction: This product-over-sum relationship is a favourite examiner shortcut.
problems.verifierReason: Original calls it harmonic mean, but formula lacks factor 2; correction removes incorrect label.

problems.quote: ratio (30‑30):(40‑30) = 0:10, meaning only the cheaper variety is used
problems.problem: Incorrect alligation ratio; the correct ratio is based on (Cₘ‑C₂):(C₁‑Cₘ)
problems.correction: ratio (36‑30):(40‑36) = 6:4 = 3:2, so both varieties are used
problems.verifierReason: Original alligation ratio miscomputed; correction using (Cm‑C2):(C1‑Cm) yields 3:2, indicating both varieties are used.
